summary: std/asn1: `parse` stops at Go's 10000 nesting levels with `asn1: structure error: nesting depth exceeded` (GO-2026-5972)
details: `parse` stops at Go's 10000 nesting levels with `asn1: structure error: nesting depth exceeded` (GO-2026-5972); deeper input could exhaust the stack. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/asn1): `parse` stops at Go's 10000 nesting levels with `asn1: structure error: nesting depth exceeded` (GO-2026-5972); deeper input could exhaust the stack. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
